name: publish-gate
description: Check a draft's numbers against your facts.md and its links before you publish.
long_description: Two checks to run on a draft before it goes out. check_numbers fails each number that is not in your facts file and has no [src: URL] on the same line; years, times, version strings and list numbering are exempt. check_links fetches each URL and fails any that errors or returns HTTP 400 or higher, and any URL containing 'checkout' without utm_source. Zero dependencies.

tools.name: check_numbers
tools.description: Fail each number in a draft that is not in the facts file and has no [src: URL] on its line (years, times, versions and list numbering exempt).

tools.name: check_links
tools.description: Fail any URL in a draft that errors or returns HTTP 400 or higher, and any URL containing 'checkout' without utm_source.
